sky cinema premiere.title: Couples Weekend
sky cinema premiere.desc: Trapped in a cosy cabin by a blizzard, two couples ring in the new year with a mysterious cocktail that strips away their inhibitions, turning their romantic getaway into a showdown of secrets, betrayals and rapidly shifting loyalties.

sky cinema premiere.title: Midwinter Break
sky cinema premiere.desc: A couple realize their relationship has reached a crossroads while on holiday in Amsterdam. After so much time and so many memories, long-held promises and deeply concealed wounds threaten to come to light and force them to confront their future.

sky cinema premiere.title: Finnegan's Foursome
sky cinema premiere.desc: Two brothers and their adult children head to Ireland to honour their late father's final wish by scattering his ashes on a golf course. What starts as a clash of egos, old grudges and comic misadventures soon turns into a week of bonding and warmth.

sky cinema action.title: The Fast and the Furious
sky cinema action.desc: An undercover cop infiltrates a gang of LA street racers while investigating a rash of truck robberies.

sky cinema action.title: 2 Fast 2 Furious
sky cinema action.desc: To clear his criminal record a former LA cop must infiltrate the Miami street-racing scene to set up a drug baron. Burning rubber all over the city with his ex-con friend, he attempts to deliver the crook to the FBI without crashing and being blown to pieces in one of the many explosions.

sky cinema action.title: The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift
sky cinema action.desc: Street-racing sequel following an adrenaline-junkie automobile addict who narrowly avoids jail by agreeing to move in with his father in Tokyo. However, he soon discovers the thrill of the local underground drift racing scene and unwittingly becomes involved with the Yakuza.

sky cinema action.title: Fast & Furious
sky cinema action.desc: Dominic Toretto is forced to come out of hiding when a loved one is brutally murdered. Heading to LA to track down the culprit, he crosses paths with Brian O'Connor, the FBI agent whose undercover infiltration of Toretto's gang led to the motorised miscreant's exile across the border. The two men temporarily put their differences aside as they investigate the killing.

sky cinema family.title: Happy Feet
sky cinema family.desc: Son of Memphis and Norma, little sweet penguin Mumble has a big problem: he can't sing a single note. In a world where everyone needs a heart song to attract a soul mate, Mumble feels he doesn't belong there. Our hero Mumble is the worst singer in the world, but he can tap dance brilliantly.

sky cinema family.title: Happy Feet Two
sky cinema family.desc: Mumble's son Erik hasn't yet found his talents, and he goes with his friends to Adélie-land which is ruled by a penguin who can fly. When Erik returns to Emperor-land and finds them trapped under big walls of ice. Will Erik be able to save his family and friends before it is too late?

sky cinema family.title: Peter Rabbit
sky cinema family.desc: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

sky cinema family.title: The Secret Life of Pets
sky cinema family.desc: A domesticated terrier and his unruly canine pal encounter a rebellious bunny and his gang of abandoned pets.

sky cinema comedy.title: About Last Night
sky cinema comedy.desc: Four Los Angeles singles experience undeniable chemistry and pair off to follow their attraction to its logical conclusion. Afterward, each new couple tries to make love last in the real world.

sky cinema comedy.title: Mother's Pride
sky cinema comedy.desc: About a failing pub, a divided community, and a grieving family whose lives are changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards.

sky cinema comedy.title: Instant Family
sky cinema comedy.desc: When Pete and Ellie decide to start a family, they stumble into the world of foster care adoption. They hope to take in one small child, but when they meet three siblings, including a rebellious 15-year-old girl, they find themselves speeding from zero to three kids overnight. Now, Pete and Ellie must try to learn the ropes of instant parenthood in the hope of becoming a family.

sky cinema comedy.title: Paul
sky cinema comedy.desc: On a pilgrimage to America's UFO heartland, two British sci-fi geeks meet an extraterrestrial and hatch a plan to help him return to his spaceship.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: The Last Starfighter
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A teenage video-game whiz is recruited as an interstellar fighter pilot by an emissary from a league of planets.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Beast of War
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: During World War II, a Japanese fighter sinks an Australian warship in the Timor Sea. Clinging to a makeshift raft, a handful of soldiers soon find themselves in a desperate fight for survival as a great white shark circles in the water.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Oblivion
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Two weeks before he is scheduled to depart from devastated planet Earth forever, a drone repairman rescues a woman from a downed spaceship, triggering a final battle to save mankind.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Gattaca
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: The world of genetically engineered children has come to pass, and people are divided into two classes - valid and invalid. The valid are the chosen ones, given the best jobs and are entitled to the best of everything. Vincent Freeman is not a valid, although he harbours a secret desire to join the space programme. He meets a crippled valid who helps him assume his identity in order to fulfil this dream.

sky cinema thriller.title: Sharp Corner
sky cinema thriller.desc: A dedicated family man becomes obsessed with saving the lives of the car accident victims on the sharp corner in front of his house - an obsession that could cost him everything.

sky cinema thriller.title: RocknRolla
sky cinema thriller.desc: Small-time crooks One Two and Mumbles decide to legitimately invest in some prime real estate and find themselves out of their depth and in debt to old-school London gangster Lenny Cole. Cole himself is in the middle of a business deal with a Russian gangster, but when his accountant tips off One Two and Mumbles to the details of an upcoming big-money business transaction, the two scallywags swoop in and steal the cash.

sky cinema thriller.title: Revolver
sky cinema thriller.desc: Jake Green is a hotshot gambler, long on audacity and short on common sense. Jake served seven years in jail for a crime he didn't commit after taking the rap for mean crime boss Dorothy Macha. Upon his release he takes on Macha in a private casino game, causes humiliation, and wins. While Macha puts out an order on Jake's life, Jake meets brothers Avi and Zach who protect him and plot to take Macha down.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Bank Job
sky cinema thriller.desc: London, 1971: Terry Leather's ex-girlfriend Martine turns up with a tempting proposition. A bank's alarm is scheduled to be turned off for a week, so Terry and his team tunnel through to the vault from a neighbouring property.

sky cinema greats.title: Liar Liar
sky cinema greats.desc: A slick attorney fails to show up for his son's fifth birthday, prompting the boy to make a wish that his father would tell the truth for just one day. Miraculously, the wish is granted and for the next 24 hours, the formerly mendacious lawyer is unable to tell a single lie.

sky cinema greats.title: Caddyshack
sky cinema greats.desc: A rich property developer wants to take over an exclusive country club and so challenges its pompous president to a game of golf leading to utter mayhem, and a stream of surreal and crude visual gags.

sky cinema greats.title: The Wedding Singer
sky cinema greats.desc: When one-time rock hopeful Robbie is jilted at the altar, he vents his bitterness in song, even when singing at other people's weddings. Only true love can redeem the broken hearted songster but fortunately, he's about to meet a woman who will spin him right round (like a record).

sky cinema greats.title: Kindergarten Cop
sky cinema greats.desc: Comic tale in which a tough cop is forced to go undercover as a kindergarten teacher. In his new role, he must track down a mother and son who are the only witnesses against a drug-dealing criminal, who is also their husband and father. The cop uses his brutal methods to negotiate the mundane problems of child control.

sky cinema drama.title: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
sky cinema drama.desc: When his father's job results in a family move to the countryside, young German boy Bruno misses his old friends. Roaming the grounds of the large country house he now calls home, he discovers the huge fenced facility that his dad Ralf, a Nazi officer, now manages. Approaching it, Bruno meets Shmuel, a fellow youngster on the other side of the barbed wire, wearing what appears to be a pair of pyjamas.

sky cinema drama.title: Hamlet
sky cinema drama.desc: An electrifying reimagining of Shakespeare's Hamlet, starring Riz Ahmed and set in the world of a British South Asian family in contemporary London.

sky cinema drama.title: Jackie
sky cinema drama.desc: The days leading up to the tragedy of President John F. Kennedy's assassination and its immediate aftermath are chronicled as they were experienced by the First Lady, wife of the charismatic president and mother of two small children.

sky cinema drama.title: Valentine's Day
sky cinema drama.desc: Following a group of Los Angeles' residents who try to find their way through the highs and lows of love during a single day.
